quota_usage.before_log_hint: Used before logging began; it cannot be split by session
quota_usage.before_note: Hatched: the {{value}} used before logging began on {{when}}; it cannot be split by session. It goes away once {{accounts}}.
quota_usage.not_read_note: No quota reading this week yet: no request ran and no poll has come in.
quota_usage.range_unread_note: Logging began on {{when}}: the percentage counts use from then on, and hatched days before it show tokens only.
quota_usage.range_unread_before_note: Logging began on {{when}}: the percentage counts use from then on, plus the {{value}} that week had already used (used before logging). Hatched days before it show tokens only.
quota_usage.range_unknown_note: No quota reading fell in this range, so what it used is not known; its tokens still count below.
quota_usage.range_unread_accounts_note: {{accounts}} had no quota reading in this range, so its use is not in the figure.
quota_usage.range_unplaced_note: {{value}} more may lie on either side of the range start, so it is left out: use before logging in a week that began earlier, or a rise read across the range start that no request explains.
quota_usage.range_undated_note: {{value}} of the use not matched to a request was read across midnight: it is in the figure, on no day.
quota_usage.not_logged_note: No request has gone through the proxy since logging began, so this cannot be split by project yet.
quota_usage.outside_hint: The reading rose more than the requests through the proxy explain: most likely use outside the proxy (the provider's website or apps, another tool or device), possibly an error of the estimate
quota_usage.daily_label: Usage per day, coloured by project
quota_usage.stretch_unsettled: Not settled by a reading yet
quota_usage.kind_cacheRead_hint: Each turn re-reads the conversation so far; the most tokens at the lowest price
quota_usage.kind_cacheWrite_hint: New content written to the cache the first time

quota_usage.empty_search: No project or session matches the search.
quota_usage.unavailable_desc: The quota-pilot plugin needs to be running.
quota_usage.method_quota: Weekly quota %: each time an account's weekly percentage rises by 1%, the rise is split among the requests through the proxy since, weighted by tokens and model price (output 5×, cache write 2×, cache read 0.1×; Opus and Fable 5×, Sonnet 3×). Providers report whole percents, so a session's figure can be off by about 1%. A rise those requests cannot explain counts as not matched to a request: most likely use outside the proxy, possibly an error of the estimate. A rise read across the start of a 7 or 30 day range that no request explains is left out, as it may have come before.
quota_usage.method_total: Total: each account is worked out on its own week and the results are added up, in units of one account's weekly quota, so the total runs to the number of accounts × 100%.
quota_usage.method_range: 7 and 30 days: each account's readings are followed across every weekly window the range touches, and what was used inside the range is added up. The unit stays one account's weekly quota, so a range can pass 100%. Use found at the first reading counts only when its week began inside the range. Quota readings start when logging began; days before that show tokens recovered from the Claude Code transcripts of the machine that runs the proxy.
quota_usage.session_none_also: plus requests not in any session
quota_usage.why_sdk_ts: Opened by a TypeScript program through the Claude Agent SDK, such as a plugin hook.
quota_usage.why_sdk_py: Opened by a Python program through the Claude Agent SDK, such as a plugin hook.
quota_usage.why_print: A one-off claude -p run, usually from a script.
quota_usage.why_codex_exec: A one-off codex exec run, usually from a script or another tool.
quota_usage.why_claude_code: Codex started by Claude Code, such as by its Codex plugin.
quota_usage.why_remote: Claude Code on another computer, named by the quota band there.
quota_usage.total_hint_5h: Each account 100%, on its own window
quota_usage.all_week_hint_5h: Each provider in its own quota, never added together
quota_usage.period_week_own_5h: Running windows · each account on its own
quota_usage.not_read_note_5h: No quota reading in this window yet: no request ran and no poll has come in.
quota_usage.unused_note_5h: Nothing used in the running windows. With none running, the next request starts one.
quota_usage.restart_note: {{account}} started over on {{when}} (a plan change, or a reset you asked for): this week counts from then. What it used before shows in the last 7 days.
quota_usage.restart_note_5h: {{account}} started over on {{when}} (a plan change, or a reset you asked for): this window counts from then. The window before shows in the bars above.
quota_usage.restart_note_5h_unlisted: {{account}} started over on {{when}} (a plan change, or a reset you asked for): this window counts from then.
quota_usage.five_idle: No window running: the next request starts one
quota_usage.windows_label: 5-hour windows of the last day, coloured by project
quota_usage.windows_from_note: Some earlier 5-hour windows are not listed: readings before {{when}} did not record when their window reset.
quota_usage.method_5h: 5-hour window: each account's running 5-hour window, split the same way as the week, in units of one account's 5-hour window. A window starts with the first request after the last one ended and resets five hours on; the bars show the windows of the last day.
quota_usage.method_tier: Service tier: the tier each request asked for (Codex sends Fast as priority) and the one the provider reported in its answer. Requests from before 0.1.5 have no record.
